data.body: FAST-FOLLOW UPDATE (ADR-0022 pivot, 2026-06-04): the prior FAST-FOLLOW's is_sha_review_equivalent predicate (clean-merge -> admin-exemption-ledger HMAC -> covering-PR-proven) is REVISED — the admin-exemption-ledger HMAC arm is RETIRED. ADR-0022 supersedes it with identity-based admin exemption: a covering PR merged by a designated bypass-actor (ruleset.bypass_user_ids, server-set merged_by) is reviewed-equivalent, folded into rc_sha_is_reviewed (review-coverage-lib.sh) + the verify-session-provenance G3 loop. So the shared review-equivalence is now: clean-merge OR merged_by-in-bypass-set OR covering-PR-review-passed — already consulted by BOTH gates (the duplication the FAST-FOLLOW targeted is reduced; the merged_by extraction is the one KEEP-IN-SYNC point). DD6's 3-consumer equivalence test still applies, to the identity-based predicate. NOTE: 0cd7's OWN shared helper (rc_diff_is_tickets_only, the DIFF-scoped ticket/version exemption) is a SEPARATE concern from admin-exemption and is UNAFFECTED by the pivot.
